sources.snippet: Parcel Pilot MCP lets you scan a shopping-site login QR code once, keeps the browser session in a private local profile, and gives your AI client structured package data through MCP. Ask your assistant: Show me all packages that are still on the way. Did anything arrive today? Track my Taobao order from last week.
